speaker: william_shakespeare
text: She is still above. The close is grey. I am not opening the casement to hurry it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Leave the casement. The apples can sit in a grey light without a speech. I have the beer. I have not cut.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not cut. If I arrive at a table already served, she will say I was down before I was called, and she will be right, and I would like her to have the pleasure of saying it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: You will get the pleasure. I am not spending it for you. The notch is a thumb short. I will let her hear that from me, once, and then I am done with bakers for the morning.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nine, then dinner, then the afternoon. Between those I mean to be where the paper is. This house gets the hours it can see me in, and no report of the others.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I do not want a report. I want the end of the loaf still whole when she comes down that stair. Sit up. I can hear the comb go down on the chest.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am sitting up. Tell her I have been no trouble, if it is still true when she sees me.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: It is true until you speak. Here she is.
